summary: Comprehensive frontend testing of Waste Tycoon game completed. Tested all 6 requested features: mobile responsiveness, PNG icons for vehicles/facilities, vehicle markers on map, dispatch system job progression, route visualization, and full game loop. All features working correctly.

issues: Minor: 'Made with Emergent' badge can intercept clicks on bottom-right buttons - use force=True or JS click as workaround

passed_tests: Mobile responsiveness (375px viewport) - hamburger menu works, sidebar slides in/out
Mobile Map page - compact header, filter buttons, site panel at bottom
Mobile Shop page - 2-column grid, depot selector, buy/lease toggle
Mobile Contracts page - stats cards in 2x2 grid, contract cards responsive
Mobile Dispatch page - step-by-step selection UI, stats cards responsive
Mobile Facilities page - facility list, details panel, hire staff button
PNG icons for vehicles - Small Tipper icon visible on map during active job
PNG icons for facilities - Different icons for industrial estates, quarries, depots
Owned facility shows green badge and glow effect on map
Vehicle markers on map - Vehicle marker with red pulsing dot visible during active job
Vehicle position updates - Vehicle moved from Carlisle to Edinburgh during job
Route polylines - Blue dashed polyline visible on map during dispatch
Dispatch system - Jobs progress through statuses (en_route_pickup -> loading -> en_route_delivery -> unloading -> returning -> completed)
Job completion - Job completed successfully, payment received, reputation increased
Full game loop: Buy depot (£50,000) -> Buy vehicle (£35,000) -> Hire driver (£2,000) -> Accept contract -> Dispatch job -> Job completes -> Get paid
Cash updates correctly after each transaction
Vehicle condition decreases after job completion (wear system working)
Fleet page shows vehicle details, condition bar, sell button
Marketplace page shows material prices and inventory
Help page shows save slots, autosave info, delete protection, game speed info
Time controls (1x, 2x, 5x, 10x) and pause/play working
Navigation unlocks after buying first depot
Contracts generate automatically and can be accepted
Active jobs indicator (truck icon with count) in header
seed_data_creation: None - game uses localStorage for save data
context_for_next_testing_agent: All requested features are working correctly. The full game loop (buy depot -> buy vehicle -> hire driver -> accept contract -> dispatch -> job completes -> get paid) works end-to-end. Mobile responsiveness is excellent with hamburger menu and responsive layouts. PNG icons are displayed for both vehicles and facilities on the map. Vehicle markers move during active jobs and route polylines are visible. The dispatch system correctly progresses jobs through all statuses and completes them with payment.
